svg.aria-label: Selected engineering interests. 01 Legacy modernization: Improving existing systems without compromising their behavior. 02 Software architecture: Organizing code around clear responsibilities and boundaries. 03 Performance: Understanding bottlenecks and optimizing where it matters. 04 Developer tooling: Automating repetitive tasks and improving development workflows. 05 User experience: Making technical applications more intuitive and efficient. 06 AI engineering: Exploring practical applications of AI and machine learning (exploring). 07 Systems programming: Understanding lower-level concepts through languages such as Rust (exploring).
